title: Bug: connected pump no longer is displayed in AAPS
body:
Reporting bugs
--------------
- After connecting a dana i pump following deployment of AAPS 3.4.x on Android 13.

- Pump serial number no longer displays on the pump preferences screen but it displays of the Pump tab screen.  Previous versions AAPS eg. 3.2.0.4 displayed the serial number on both screens.

_Originally posted by @bobhome007 in https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/issues/4488_

comments.body:
this is already refactored in v4
will not be changed in v3
